DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome (with Eisenmenger physiology causing cyanotic heart disease, anemia, and apnea).

I have reviewed the history of maternal rubella and premature birth with respiratory support; the combination of apnea, anemia, and a family history of heart issues strongly suggests a congenital heart defect like an ASD or VSD causing Eisenmenger syndrome. I am proceeding with a final confirmation based on these findings without further questioning.
